definitions.gloss: out of stock; sold out; inventory depletion
definitions.explanation: the state of having no more items available for sale; when inventory has been exhausted

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{在庫切|ざいこぎ}れです。
examples.english: That product is out of stock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}{商品|しょうひん}→人気商品：21609_ninkishouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧{在庫切|ざいこぎ}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Popular products quickly go out of stock.

examples.japanese: {在庫切|ざいこぎ}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{付|つ}けられません→受け付ける：05683_uketsukeru⟧。
examples.english: We cannot accept orders due to being out of stock.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧ (inventory, stock) + {切|き}れ (running out, depletion)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {在庫切|ざいこぎ}れ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to go out of stock)
- {在庫切|ざいこぎ}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧... (because of being out of stock)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧あり (in stock)
- ⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧ (stock check)
- ⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧ (sold out - synonym)
- ⟦{再入荷|さいにゅうか}→再入荷：08768_sainyuuka⟧ (restocking)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{品切|しなぎ}れ→品切れ：09557_shinagire⟧ is used interchangeably and is slightly more common in casual speech.
